title: Grua, Freeman, Tupper & Young, PLC
description: Grua, Freeman, Tupper & Young, PLC Grua, Freeman, Tupper & Young, PLC is a law firm based in Lansing, Michigan, at 2401 East Grand River Avenue. Founded in 1996 as a professional corporation, the firm serves individuals, families, small and mid-sized businesses, nonprofits and municipalities.The team includes seven attorneys - Remo Mark Grua, Timothy P. Young, Carrie S. Ihrig Freeman, Thomas M. Tupper, Brian M. Lum, Elizabeth M. Wilbur and Roger M. Smith - supported by of counsel attorneys, legal assistants and administrative staff.Practice areas cover litigation, personal injury, business law, real estate, probate and estate planning, family law, employment, nonprofit organizations and bankruptcy. The firm handles matters in Michigan courts, including Ingham County and surrounding counties, as well as real estate transactions, leases, trusts, bankruptcy proceedings and mediation.The firm's approach is personal: each client works directly with the attorney responsible for the matter. Contact: (517) 487-8300, info@wedolawinlansing.com, wedolawinlansing.com.    More
